newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded basis, prices firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded basis, prices firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices firmed on Monday as strengthening differentials offset easing futures prices, traders said.
Jet fuel basis also continued its steady climb on reports of refiner buying in the Chicago market and strong demand in the region, traders said.
"There's been some non-Chicago area refiner buying in the Chicago market," one trader said. Strong demand has propelled jet/kero basis higher over the past two weeks.
Group Three prompt low sulphur diesel was bid 3.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil, with high sulphur talked 0.75 cent a gallon over the print.
Chicago prompt low sulphur was bid 3.50 cents over the print, with high sulphur 1.50 cent over, traders said.
Group Three unleaded gasoline was heard done 2.60 cents a gallon over NYMEX March unleaded, with premium 3.25 cents higher.
Chicago unleaded was talked 0.25 cent under to even with the print for prompt barrels, with premium 3.0 cents higher.
Jet/kero rose to bids 7.25 cents over the print in Group Three and 4.75 cents over in Chicago, traders said.
